high_level_description: Woman: She is on the left side of the image. She has long, wavy blonde hair that falls over her shoulders. She is wearing a beige blazer with black tiger stripe patterns. Her outfit includes black shorts or a skirt and sheer tights. She is accessorized with a gold necklace and a ring on her right hand. She is wearing a white cap with the "Red Bull" logo prominently displayed, along with the Red Bull Racing branding. She has a lanyard around her neck with a yellow badge that appears to be related to an event (possibly Formula 1, as indicated by the "F1" and "Red Bull Racing" logos).
